command:
set -euo pipefail
expected=2f9fa1004ab140eb312302f799bf2e6165c4aff6
actual=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
[[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || { echo "HEAD_MISMATCH actual=$actual expected=$expected" >&2; exit 71; }
[[ -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=no)" ]] || { echo 'TRACKED_WORKTREE_DIRTY' >&2; git status --porcelain=v1; exit 72; }
before_pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
before_epoch=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value)
[[ "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)" == active ]] || { echo 'VM_NOT_ACTIVE_PRE' >&2; exit 73; }
echo "PRE head=$actual pid=$before_pid epoch=$before_epoch"
sudo -n python3 /home/andreas/self-integration/werkzeug/fluechtig-zustand-sichern.py --run-id fred-20260913T0246p0700
after_pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
after_epoch=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value)
[[ "$before_pid" == "$after_pid" && "$before_epoch" == "$after_epoch" ]] || { echo "RUNTIME_DRIFT before=$before_pid/$before_epoch after=$after_pid/$after_epoch" >&2; exit 74; }
echo "POST state=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value) pid=$after_pid epoch=$after_epoch"
echo 'NO_VM_STOP=1'
echo 'NO_VM_RESTART=1'
echo 'NO_WRITER_CUTOVER=1'
